offers_products.reason: Sells WAKIX (pitolisant), a prescription drug for narcolepsy; pipeline in rare epilepsy.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling a pharmaceutical product; patient support programs are incidental.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients with narcolepsy take WAKIX and choose with prescribers; patient-focused marketing, though dispensed via specialty pharmacy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells WAKIX to specialty pharmacies/distributors, which buy for dispensing to patients.

recurring_revenue.reason: Patients stay on chronic narcolepsy therapy, generating ongoing monthly prescription refills of WAKIX.

cyclical_demand.reason: Prescription medicine for chronic neurological condition; patients unlikely to cut therapy in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Monthly prescription refills are small, frequent purchases for the buyer.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for a patented drug product, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: End buyers are patients; distributors are specialty pharmacies, with consumers the main end users.

asset_heavy.reason: Commercial-stage drug company outsourcing manufacturing; growth needs R&D and sales force, not plants or fleets.

notes: Based on knowledge of WAKIX sales via specialty pharmacies; website text alone is thin.
